> **A match requires fan-out, and nothing downgrades it.** Not size, not simplicity, not that the change is obvious, not that it is "only" a value.

Even though the diff is small (5 lines across 2 files) and the change appears straightforward, **a constant value on the sensitive surface still requires fan-out**. The skill document explicitly lists constants as part of the surface:

> A constant, a default, a fixture row and a migration file are all the surface.

Serial review would be appropriate only if this touched no sensitive surface at all. That threshold does not apply here.
